waste_categories.name: Organic / Wet Waste
waste_categories.description: Biodegradable organic food scraps, vegetable peels, garden waste, tea bags, and coffee grounds.

waste_categories.name: Dry / Recyclable Waste
waste_categories.description: Paper, clean cardboard, cartons, and generic dry clean recyclables.

waste_categories.name: Plastic
waste_categories.description: PET/HDPE bottles, containers, clean wraps, jugs, and recyclable polymers.

waste_categories.name: Glass
waste_categories.description: Beverage bottles, jars, intact glassware. Keep separate to avoid shattering.

waste_categories.name: Metal
waste_categories.description: Aluminum beverage cans, tin food cans, foil, bottle caps, small metallic scrap.

waste_categories.name: E-Waste
waste_categories.description: Electronic components, old cables, phones, circuit boards, chargers. Requires authorized recycler.

waste_categories.name: Hazardous Waste
waste_categories.description: Batteries, paint cans, pesticides, chemicals, fluorescent tubes, medical waste. Handle with care!

waste_categories.name: Non-Recyclable Waste
waste_categories.description: Heavily soiled wrappers, multilayer laminates, hygiene products, ceramics, residual trash.
